topics.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for complex coding, reasoning and agent workflows
topics.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, positioning it between Hydrogen and Carbon for coding, multistep tool use, and enterprise knowledge work. It offers a 1-million-token context window, configurable thinking levels, and API pricing of $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, rolling out in the Gemini app, API, and GitHub Copilot.

topics.title: UK financial regulators publish AI cyber risk and resilience effective practices
topics.summary: On November 19, the Bank of England, Prudential Regulation Authority, and Financial Conduct Authority proposed principles-based cyber resilience guidance alongside non-binding effective practices on AI-related cyber risk. The guidance addresses faster AI-enabled vulnerability exploitation, continuous exposure management, and human oversight, with consultation on the broader cyber framework open until February 26, 2027.

topics.title: Model ML raises $250 million Series B at $1.5 billion valuation for financial AI agents
topics.summary: London-based Model ML announced a $250 million Series B round at a $1.5 billion valuation on November 17, co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors. The round brings total funding to $350 million as the startup expands engineering teams in London and New York to deploy personal AI agents for bankers, consultants, and investors.
